decisive_items: A working diagnosis of probable RICH was made.
it revealed one large vein with an extensive network of small superficial branching vessels localized to the area of the atrophic plaque
response.rationale: The explicit working diagnosis is RICH, and the infrared vein finder demonstrating a large vein with superficial branching vessels within the atrophic plaque supports a vascular lesion rather than a smooth muscle hamartoma or lipoatrophy.

rejected.why: Semiannular lipoatrophy was only an initial differential consideration and does not explain the prominent vascular network seen within the plaque.
Smooth muscle hamartoma was only an initial differential consideration; the demonstrated vascular pattern is more consistent with RICH.
